articles.title: Some migrants ready to pack bags fearing far-right win in east German state
articles.summary: As a far-right regional election victory looms in an ex-communist eastern German state, many migrants are readying to pack their bags, fearful of the AfD party's threatened "deportation and remigration offensive".
